What Drives Me

Creativity and structure have always been at the core of who I am. Growing up, I was introduced early to the world of computers. I fondly remember spending countless hours in my father's study playing computer games and learning to type, captivated by how certain products could leave a lasting impression.

Finding purpose

This early fascination with computer systems inspired me to pursue a degree in Computer Science and laid the foundation for my career in design.

Beyond Design

When I’m not immersed in Figma or sketching out ideas, you will catch me working out, playing video games or hanging with friends.

 Additionally, I’m passionate about mentoring junior designers and envision contributing to the global design community.

text:
Elevating a Premium Electric Vehicle Brand in Nigeria

Industry

Automobile

Client

EN1 Technologies

Service

Mobile & Web

Date

2023-2024

Project Overview

In the growing electric vehicle (EV) market, EN1 aspired to be the leading name in Nigeria. To achieve this, they needed more than just a cutting-edge product—they required a compelling digital presence that could connect with potential customers, elevate their brand, and drive conversions. My role as Design Lead was to spearhead their digital transformation, ensuring that the digital experience mirrored the luxury and performance of their vehicles.

Role & Responsibility

As Design Lead, I was responsible for:

Visual Design: Creating a cohesive, luxury-focused aesthetic for the entire digital experience.

User Flows & Prototyping: Mapping out user journeys across the website, mobile app, configurator, and internal portals.

Collaboration: Working closely with developers and stakeholders to ensure the design translated well into the final product.

The Problem

How do you create a luxury digital experience that’s functional, seamless, and resonates with a local audience?

EN1 was targeting Nigerian consumers—a market driven by rising fuel prices and growing interest in sustainable transportation options. My task was to craft a user-centric digital platform that would:

Showcase EN1’s electric vehicles in a compelling, premium way.

Allow users to explore and customize vehicles.

Promote brand merchandise and generate additional revenue.

Create a backend system to streamline operations for EN1’s internal team.

But it wasn’t just about creating a visually appealing site. I had to ensure a seamless, intuitive experience across all digital touchpoints (website, mobile app, configurator, kitshop, and admin portal). Each element had to embody the luxury and performance EN1 promised.

Understanding the User

The first step was understanding who we were designing for. EN1’s primary audience was Nigerian users seeking alternatives to rising petrol costs while embracing luxury and sustainable options. They needed:

A simple, intuitive platform that made it easy to explore vehicles.

Content that felt relevant to their local culture and needs.

A seamless mobile-first experience, as a majority of users would be interacting through smartphones.

We conducted market research and user interviews to identify key pain points, preferences, and behaviors. These insights became the foundation for the design approach.

Framing the Problem

Based on user feedback, the challenge was clear: we needed to create a premium yet practical digital experience for EN1, one that balanced aesthetic appeal with functionality. Users wanted an effortless, luxurious journey, whether they were browsing cars or purchasing merchandise.

How do we showcase luxury without compromising usability?

How do we make the platform relevant to Nigerian consumers?

How do we ensure seamless functionality across multiple platforms (website, app, configurator, kitshop, and admin portal)?

Finding structure:

To solve these challenges, I explored several concepts for how EN1 could present a cohesive, premium brand experience across its platforms. We focused on:

A sleek, minimalist design to reflect EN1's luxury status.

Localized content with relevant cultural references and language to resonate with Nigerian users.

Responsive design, ensuring the experience felt seamless whether users were on desktop or mobile.

A car configurator that let users visualize and customize their vehicles, elevating customer engagement.

Bringing Ideas to Life

We moved quickly into prototyping, focusing on creating intuitive user flows that balanced luxury with ease of use.

Website & Mobile App:

Designed a minimalist homepage with high-quality images and smooth interactions, making it easy for users to explore vehicles while feeling the premium nature of the brand.

Developed a car configurator, enabling users to visualize their ideal vehicle—color, trim, features—in real time. This added a personal touch, letting customers feel connected to their purchase.

Created a kitshop for EN1-branded merchandise, reinforcing brand identity and allowing for additional revenue streams.

Admin Portal:

Built a simple, intuitive admin dashboard for EN1’s internal team to manage car orders, merchandise, and customer inquiries.

Conlusion

To lead in Nigeria's electric vehicle market, EN1 recognized that innovation alone wasn’t enough—it required a digital experience that matched the sophistication and quality of their vehicles. By spearheading their digital transformation, I ensured every interaction embodied the brand’s luxury and performance values, effectively connecting with prospective customers and achieving measurable outcomes.

This project highlighted the significance of aligning design with business goals, showcasing how user-focused digital strategies can strengthen a brand and enhance engagement. It also taught me the importance of cross-functional collaboration in crafting cohesive solutions and the need for flexibility when addressing the challenges of emerging markets. These experiences continue to inform my approach to designing meaningful, user-centered solutions moving forward.

text:
Roqqu: Redesigning a Seamless Cryptocurrency Experience

Industry

Crypto

Client

Roqqu

Service

Mobile Application

Date

2023-2024

Project Overview

Roqqu, a leading cryptocurrency platform, focuses on providing a secure and user-friendly environment for trading and managing digital assets. 

Role & Responsibility

As a product designer specializing in UX/UI, I was tasked with enhancing the platform's usability and functionality while addressing key user needs. Using the design thinking approach, I aimed to simplify user onboarding, improve transaction efficiency, and empower users through education and essential tools.

Understanding User Needs

To build a product that resonates with users, I began by conducting thorough research. I used a mix of qualitative and quantitative methods to uncover their pain points, frustrations, and expectations.

Identifying the Core Problems

With the research insights, I defined several key challenges:

Simplifying the KYC process to make onboarding easier and less time-consuming.

Creating a comprehensive educational platform to empower users with the knowledge needed to confidently navigate the crypto space.

Developing essential tools (rate checker, network checker, transaction checker) to give users real-time information, helping them make informed decisions.

Optimizing fiat transactions with Qash, ensuring a smooth conversion experience across various fiat currencies.

Key Findings:

Complexity of Onboarding: Many new users found the KYC process and registration flow to be time-consuming and confusing. 

Lack of Educational Resources: Users expressed a desire for more educational content to help them understand cryptocurrency concepts. 

Need for Essential Tools: Users sought features to track market trends, check transaction status, and compare different cryptocurrencies. 

Security Concerns: Users were concerned about the security of their funds and data, especially when conducting transactions.

Redesigning the KYC Experience

I designed a simplified process that guides users step-by-step, ensuring compliance without unnecessary friction..

Simplified documentation upload: Users could easily submit identity documents via mobile or desktop.

Automated real-time verification: Integrated automated verification for faster processing.

Clear guidance: Provided users with step-by-step instructions, reducing confusion.

Designing Qash: A Fiat Based Solution

One of the primary challenges faced by cryptocurrency users is the complexity of converting fiat currencies (like USD, EUR, or NGN) into digital assets. The Qash feature was designed to address this issue by providing a simple and efficient way for users to perform fiat-based transactions within the Roqqu platform.

Creating an Engaging Academy Experience

To address the lack of educational resources for cryptocurrency users, the Academy feature was designed to provide a comprehensive learning platform within the Roqqu app. It featured:

Curated learning paths: Tailored learning journeys for both beginners and advanced users.

Interactive content: Quizzes, videos, and case studies made the learning experience more engaging.

Developing Essential Tools for Users

To provide users with the information they need to make informed decisions and troubleshoot issues, I designed the following tools: 

Rate Checker: A real-time tool that displayed current exchange rates for various cryptocurrencies. 

Network Checker: A feature that allowed users to check the status of different blockchain networks. 

Transaction Checker: A tool that provided users with detailed information about their transaction history, including status, fees, and confirmation times.

Conclusion

Through my work on the Roqqu platform, I was able to contribute significantly to the development of a user-friendly and informative cryptocurrency experience. By conducting thorough research, designing intuitive interfaces, and providing valuable tools, I helped to improve user satisfaction, increase engagement, and drive business growth.

Results and Impact
45%

Reduction in onboarding times due to improved KYC process

101,045

Transactions powered by Qash in it's first year

30%

Drop in queries, indicating clearer, more intuitive design and better user understanding.

20%

Increase in  user satisfaction scores, measured through surveys and feedback tools.
